تصطدمون (form VIII)
# تَصْطَدِمُونَ (taṣṭadimūna) /tasˤ.tˤa.di.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
# تُصْطَدَمُونَ (tuṣṭadamūna) /tusˤ.tˤa.da.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
